content_bound.calculation: independent Python protobuf framing using year 1 negative microsecond timestamp; no generated client or service executed

review.authority: Client configured Gateway identity and Profile audience actor signer match actual method policy; owner requires guard-inserted caller/actor/private VerifiedReadAuthority and exact canonical subject.
review.deadline: Client retains original context/request/JWT/task stop and 700ms edge ceiling; trace propagates remaining duration; owner authority clips original/proof/resource clocks and checks before await, after await and before return.
review.mappings: Owner ContentUnavailable->NotFound and dependency->Unavailable; client preserves NotFound vs Denied/DeadlineExceeded/CapacityExhausted/InvalidResponse/Unavailable and fences elapsed context first; no diagnostic parsing.
review.minimal_content: Both validate same canonical UUID, Unicode scalar limits/control rules, exact-empty bio absence, UTC years1..9999; consumer double-checks returned subject.
review.freshness: No positive cache/retry in either new method; repository single parameterized statement reads current profile plus deletion fence and statement_timestamp. Observation is not TTL/revision/admission.
review.cancellation_capacity: Consumer process-global nonwaiting limiter held over entire generated future; RAII releases on drop/return/error/timeout. Owner await timeout bounded; database cancellation completion is not implied.

limitations: Static producer/consumer compatibility review only; no new Cargo/rustc/test/PG or Docker execution
Prior controlled-client and producer evidence is not a fresh native combined run
Real-chain worker owns actual PG end-to-end, lock/cancellation/recovery evidence
Production TLS/key/configuration, HTTP entry/admission/session/provider/event authority and whole BE04 remain outside this review
